searchText: On today's eth1 ACD call there was a lengthy discussion about EIP-2537 (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2537) and an immediate use case was mentioned (as explained in https://medium.com/@ralexstokes/what-eth2-needs-from-eth1-over-the-next-six-months-86b01863746 by <@!539495253418180618>). I am wondering if anyone is volunteering to write that deposit contract proxy (with sig verification)? Would be good to include withdrawal credentials verification (given the public key) as well <@!425279588009246720> i'll make a pass at it Thanks!
